verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a hosted code platform like Bitbucket, so the axis applies. The pack has no first-party documentation of user-configurable retention periods, deletion workflows, or data-purge controls. The GDPR/SOC2 compliance claims and encryption at rest are adjacent compliance and security features, not retention or deletion controls. The vendor-imposed Mercurial repo deletion is not a user-controlled capability either.
